DocumentTitle.description: The instrument's caption, as printed on the first page.

BeneficiaryName.description: The party in whose favor the mortgage is granted.

CondominiumName.description: Name of the condominium regime, when the collateral is a unit.

DatedDate.description: The date the instrument bears on its face, not the recording date.

PrincipalAmount.description: Face amount of the secured note, in USD.

IsFirstLien.description: Whether the mortgage takes first lien position.

RecordingJurisdiction.description: County whose official records the deed was filed in.

DocumentReferences.description: Prior recorded instruments this deed incorporates.
